overview.incomplete_intro: I will hold the full business walkthrough until the five core setup documents are represented. The remaining files are: {missing_documents}.
overview.complete_intro: Oh nice—the core setup is complete. I’ll take you through the app and explain what the verified data says about your business in detail.

steps.message: This analytics summary starts with cash of {cash}, a current ratio of {current_ratio}, monthly recorded inflows of {revenue_month}, and {open_checks} open review checks.
This chart compares recorded inflows and operating outflows over time. The latest period shows {revenue_month} of inflows against {expenses_month} of outflows.
The cash forecast begins at {cash}, has an estimated runway of {cash_runway_days} days, and reaches a projected low point of {forecast_low_point}.
The financial-position chart explains the composition behind liquidity: current assets are {current_assets}, current liabilities are {current_liabilities}, and working capital is {working_capital}.
The profit structure uses the latest uploaded Profit and Loss statement. Reported revenue is {statement_revenue}, total costs are {statement_costs}, and provisional net profit is {statement_profit}.
Accounts shows how the evidence posts into balances. The current ratio is {current_ratio}, the quick ratio is {quick_ratio}, and debt represents {debt_to_assets_percent} of reported assets.
The account register is the audit trail behind those ratios. Draft or low-confidence classifications remain reviewable instead of silently changing final reporting.

Tax is provisional and review-required. The current taxable-income basis is {taxable_income}, the indicative income-tax estimate is {income_tax_estimate}, and there are {tax_review_count} tax or coding exceptions.
Marketing is currently in {marketing_mode} mode. It shows {marketing_spend} of spend against {marketing_revenue} of revenue context, with a displayed ROAS of {marketing_roas}.
Company Intelligence is {intelligence_status}. It only ranks competitors when comparable numeric evidence exists, and it keeps unsupported peer values blank.

Data Management places every staged file, processed source and editable context layer around Ledger AI. Connection distance controls influence, while source coverage and validation status remain available for safe decision-making.
Your permanent setup now covers all five core categories. The library contains {setup_file_count} permanent upload records and {recurring_file_count} recurring upload records.
You can also paste files into the permanent and recurring folders inside the app directory. LedgerFlow queues them through the same staged processor and archives the originals after queuing.
Settings controls NVIDIA, the permanent agent personality, clearable working context, and safe data reset. Routine accounting work remains deterministic and does not need model tokens.
That completes the guided overview. The analytics page remains a concise view of performance, liquidity, cash outlook, financial position and profit structure.
